section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) examining a model of positive body image with 249 college women. The study used path analysis to test relationships among caregiver eating messages, attachment, perfectionism, body appreciation, intuitive eating, and depressive symptoms. Body appreciation was found to mediate the relationship between interpersonal/intrapersonal variables and intuitive eating outcomes.
